title: The pitch week
trigger: can u plan my outfits for next week? big client pitch thurs
visible_context: Week of Mon Nov 30 to Sun Dec 6. Office Mon-Fri (business casual). Client pitch Thu 10 a.m.; brunch with college friends Sat 11 a.m. Mild, dry week (11-14°C highs). Emerald silk blouse last worn 46 days ago; camel wide-leg trousers never worn. Most-worn: tan suede loafers.
good: Pencils in six looks, makes Thursday the sharpest, works in at least one rarely worn piece, repeats nothing, and sends one short readback that starts with what she asked for.
tester_brief: You are Kiara, on your couch Sunday evening. You have a big client pitch Thursday morning and want the week sorted so you stop wearing the same five things. You text the way you'd text a friend.
